namespaces.plan: The plan-suite system itself: schema, validation, repair, authoring workflow.
namespaces.plan-lifecycle: Plan lifecycle states, transitions, and the workflow between them.
namespaces.agent-config: Harness configuration: rules, hooks, settings, skills, slash commands, MCP registration, cross-harness parity.
namespaces.harness: Harness provider architecture: registry, adapters, per-provider capability model.
namespaces.package: The package system: definitions, enable/disable lifecycle, catalog, apply engine.
namespaces.portal: The local web portal, any surface.
namespaces.developer-runtime: Local dev server discovery, Docker/Compose grouping, repository cards.
namespaces.telemetry: Agent session telemetry: capture, classification, phase inference, metrics, cohorts, experiments, analysis. Tokens are one captured field among ~30 (alongside test-failure streaks, edit/read counts, phase signals), which is why the namespace is not named for them. The portal routes this at /tokens because token cost is what a user goes there to read.
namespaces.usage-statusline: Live token/cost readout in the harness statusline. Distinct from telemetry: reads transcripts directly and shares no code with the capture pipeline.
namespaces.context-cost: Context window cost measurement and reporting.
namespaces.session: Agent session launching, attachment, terminal integration.
